standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the n-fold power map finite onto its image.

standard_prerequisites.name: Dimension of a group space over a field
standard_prerequisites.use: dim(G) is finite for G locally of finite type.

core_obligations: Assume f nonconstant and form the n-fold multiplication map (P1)^n -> G, (t_1, ..., t_n) |-> f(t_1) ... f(t_n).
By the product-power lemma and nonconstancy this map is finite onto its image, forcing dim(G) >= n.
Let n grow to contradict the finiteness of dim(G) for a locally finite type group space.
proof_roadmap: Power-map dimension blow-up and the finite-dimension contradiction.
difficulty_reason: The dimension growth argument is a genuine strategy; both inputs are declared external.
